ns2:course.label: Commodity Futures and Options
ns2:course.description: Development of futures trading; operation and governance of commodity exchanges; economic functions of futures trading; operational procedures and problems in using futures markets; public regulation of futures trading; evaluation of market performance. Prerequisite: ACE 222 or FIN 300 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ACE 222 or FIN 300 or equivalent.
